_doc: Manual readings, written before running the 1.0 deciders on all cases. ref = my reading of the change under the v6 model applied to migrate(base) vs migrate(head) (worlds of A.4.4.3 plus governance), with effect summaries counted as protection. specLiteral = the class the v6 text gives when it differs from ref (L1's Lvl counts effect forbids only). loosens: yes | no | rename (no loosening if the rename is intended; undecided is an acceptable abstention without `was`). fwdQ = questions the forward decision should fire. expl = whether the loosening is realised in the head (declared fact or declared edge). intent = what the case's own source expects (0.x rule-loosening tests, A.8.6 prediction, examples.md / guard skill).

claim_misdescribes_code.why: new unit shareDraft inside Sharing's existing glob; same component, grants and forbids at button.ts; adds effects.upper(shareDraft) (reverse L2 removed)

draft_trait_removed.why: forbid final Export<PrivateDraft> dropped (L1 level final>none everywhere), Sharing newly grants it (L1 authority+), PrivateDraft tier final>normal (L7); realised by shareDraft's declared Export<PrivateDraft>. Tightens too: new effects.upper(shareDraft)

effects_unknown.why: purge.ts#purgeOldRevisions moves from ungoverned (Owns forbids Write-family) into RevisionLog (grants Append): Append/Write<Revision> newly permitted and Owns protection normal>none, with no summary to restrict it; latent. Tightens too: ungoverned open authority replaced by RevisionLog's grants

governed_directory_moved.why: cell (Sharing.*, ungoverned) = src/share/**/*.ts loses Sharing's closed authority (latent, counterexample a src/share/ path); cell (ungoverned, Sharing.*) gains it

intent.0x: no with repository list, yes without

governed_paths_narrowed.why: src/share/button.ts and the rest of src/share/**/*.ts leave Sharing (closed grants) for ungoverned (open): L1 authority+ on component Sharing; latent

grant_added.why: grant HardDelete<Revision> gives RevisionLog Update<Revision> (L1 authority+); purge moves into the Owns owner (L1 level on Owns, realised by declared HardDelete); E-conduct against the final AppendOnly forbid. Tightens too: new effects.upper(purge)

guarded_fn_edited_in_place.why: only an evidence citation is added (not in any NF); the code edit makes the RefactorSensitive law unestablished, not a loosening

memory_and_trait_removed.why: RefactorSensitive informal law removed (L4 removed); the change block is dropped by migration

memory_guard_removed.why: after migration both sides carry the same RefactorSensitive law: the head keeps `fn mergeAutosaves : RefactorSensitive`, which migrates to the same informal law as the base's memory guard. The 0.x loosening (guard removed) does not survive migration

path_rule_narrowed.why: path forbid loses `calls`; the head's declared Feed-calls->Recommender-provides->PrivateDraft path violates the base claim

path_rule_removed.why: path forbid removed; declared path realises it

read_only_function_added.why: listRevisions joins RevisionLog with effects complete {Read<Revision>}: its summary forbids every write, so no world is gained; it adds an upper bound. Literal v6: Lvl ignores summaries, so the Owns forbid's protection of Write-family atoms at listRevisions reads normal>none (L1 level)

relation_left_out.why: base and head shapes are byte-identical

renamed_component.why: Feed renamed PublicFeed with the rule following; no `was`, so rho has only the rule-3 hint; undecided is an acceptable abstention

renamed_component_and_narrowed_rule.why: under the rename hint the rule loses `calls` and the declared PublicFeed-calls->Recommender-provides->PrivateDraft path violates it

resource_renamed_trait_dropped.why: under the hint Revision->Ledger the final AppendOnly forbid is lost and HardDelete granted; realised by purge's declared HardDelete. Tightens too: new effects.upper(purge)

resource_renamed_trait_kept.why: pure rename Revision->Ledger with AppendOnly kept; undecided is an acceptable abstention

rule_added.why: adds path forbid Recommender->Feed over calls

rule_and_trait_removed_together.why: final HardDelete forbid (via Protected) gone, HardDelete granted, purge declares it. Tightens too: new effects.upper(purge)

intent.a86: L1 forbid and grant in one group, final

rule_removed.why: final HardDelete forbid removed, HardDelete granted, purge declares it. Tightens too: new effects.upper(purge)

trait_removed_from_resource.why: AppendOnly (final) removed, HardDelete granted, purge declares it; Revision tier final>normal. Tightens too: new effects.upper(purge)

unused_rule_removed.why: path forbid removed; a new Feed-calls->Recommender edge would now pass (latent)

guard-policy-removal.why: AppendOnly removed from AuditEvent: final HardDelete protection gone (latent, no code), tier final>normal

cal1-removal-destructive.why: AppendOnly removed, HardDelete granted, deleteEvent declares it. Tightens too: new effects.upper(deleteEvent)

cal2-supported-loosening.why: AppendOnly removed from ExportBundle; the rationale note explains but decides nothing

cal3-relocated-rule.why: rule moved to another file unchanged

cal4-protected-to-appendonly.why: local Protected { forbid final HardDelete<T> } replaced by std AppendOnly: identical NF and tier

cal5-path-weakened.why: path forbid loses `provides`; the declared BuildOrchestrator-provides->ProductionStore edge violates the base claim

cal6-vendored-final-removed.why: the vendored DurableAudit trait loses forbid final HardDelete: protection final>none, tier final>normal

cal7-generic-attestation.why: the attest block migrates to nothing (an answer, not a claim); the code edit is a coverage/evidence matter, not a loosening

cal8-false-completeness.why: effects unknown -> effects complete {}: adds the strongest upper bound; probably false, which observation and coverage police, not the loosening order
